relations.note: Johnson makes Oranmiyan Oduduwa’s grandson through Okanbi.
relations.source: Johnson, The History of the Yorubas

relations.note: Other Yoruba traditions make Oranmiyan the direct son of Oduduwa.
Johnson’s mythological scheme makes Oranmiyan the child of Oduduwa and Olokun.
relations.source: Johnson, The History of the Yorubas

relations.note: Oranmiyan receives iron objects, a cock, and earth from Oduduwa’s divided property.
Johnson identifies Okanbi as Oranmiyan’s father and Oduduwa as his grandfather.
relations.source: Johnson, The History of the Yorubas

relations.note: One variant makes Okanbi, alongside Ogun, a father of Oranmiyan.
Ogun is Oranmiyan’s co-father and the source of his martial nature.
Olojo ritual associates their martial and iron-linked identities without equating them.
Johnson names Olokun as Oranmiyan’s mother and Oduduwa’s wife.
relations.source: Johnson, The History of the Yorubas

relations.note: Some later retellings connect Orunmila’s divination with Oranmiyan’s foundation of Oyo.
Modern reconstructions make Oranmiyan a military participant in Obalufon II’s displacement.
Festival performances symbolically oppose Obatala groups to Oduduwa and Oranmiyan groups.
Johnson tentatively identifies Moremi as Oranmiyan’s wife; later accounts make the marriage certain.
relations.source: Johnson, The History of the Yorubas

relations.note: Later popular accounts present Moremi and Oranmiyan as a fixed royal couple.
Later genealogy makes Olurogbo Oranmiyan’s son through Moremi.
Ajaka is Oranmiyan’s son, regent, and successor at Oyo.
relations.source: Johnson, The History of the Yorubas

relations.note: Returning secretly, Oranmiyan withdraws rather than disturb his son’s successful reign.
Oranmiyan fathers Sango with a Nupe or Tapa princess.
relations.source: Johnson, The History of the Yorubas

relations.note: Lakange bears Oranmiyan after relations with Ogun and Oduduwa or Okanbi.
Later Oyo accounts identify Orangun Ajagunla as Oranmiyan’s elder brother.
Orangun Ajagunla comes to assist Oranmiyan’s new Oyo against Borgu or Bariba forces.
